rationale: Price has been steadily drifting lower over the last five 1-minute candles (from 10.09 down to 10.05), sitting below the 9-EMA at 10.06 and showing no sign of recovering toward the 10.22 take-profit. The stock gapped down nearly 5% on the open and is now trading in the lower half of today's range, with momentum clearly fading. With only $5.25 in unrealized gain and the invalidation at 9.88 still a meaningful distance away, the risk/reward of holding has deteriorated enough to warrant exiting rather than waiting for either target to be hit.
